defs.def: a tall, solid, vertical post, usually round and made of stone, which supports or decorates a building or stands alone as a monument 柱；（通常为）圆形石柱；纪念柱

ex.s: I really like the idea of adding a new column to our English newspaper.
ex.t: 与他人比较可以成为一种健康的习惯

defs.def: a thing shaped like a column 圆柱状物；柱形物
one of the vertical sections into which the printed page of a book, newspaper, etc. is divided （书、报纸等印刷页上的）栏

ex.s: Of course, I visited the beautiful leaning tower, which is eight floors high, each having a round of columns, rising one above another.
ex.t: 当然，我参观了美丽的斜塔，它高达八层，每层都有一轮柱子，一个接一个地升起。

ex.s: Anyone with eyes can see that the columns on one side have sunk rather far.
ex.t: 任何有眼睛的人都可以看到，一侧的柱子已经沉得相当远了。

ex.s: What a place—I never realised the columns would be so big!
ex.t: 真是个好地方，我从没想过柱子会这么大！

ex.s: What headers would you give for columns A to D?
ex.t: 您会为列A到D提供哪些标题？

ex.s: Look at the sentences in both columns and discuss the differences between each pair.
ex.t: 查看两栏中的句子，并讨论每对句子之间的差异。

defs.def: a part of a newspaper or magazine which appears regularly and deals with a particular subject or is written by a particular writer （报刊的）专栏，栏目
a series of numbers or words arranged one under the other down a page 纵行（数字或字）
a long, moving line of people or vehicles （人或车辆排成行移动的）长列，纵队
